description: This file defines the LocationDecorator class in the OrangeHRM system, which encapsulates logic for decorating Location entities with additional behavior, such as setting related country information and fetching employee counts.

classes.name: LocationDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds additional behavior to Location entities, such as setting country data and fetching employee counts.

methods.name: setLocationService
methods.description: Sets the LocationService instance used by the decorator.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Retrieves the LocationService instance, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a Location entity.

methods.name: setCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the country of the location based on a provided country code, using the CountryService.

methods.name: getNoOfEmployees
methods.description: Returns the number of employees at the location via the LocationService.
